title: Search-Eval Grades
description: Per-product 0-3 relevance grades and NDCG from the pinned local judge. rubric_hash and gold_validation are both required: the judge's default rubric can change, so results are deterministic only at a fixed rubric, and an unvalidated judge produces numbers nobody can defend.

rubric_hash.description: L02. Identical across every job in an eval. Reproducibility cannot be claimed without it.

gold_validation.description: L03. ~30 hand-labeled (query, product) pairs. Binary relevant-vs-not agreement is the metric that matters; the judge under-penalizes cross-category junk (grades 1 rather than 0), which is conservative for a noisy-search finding and must be stated.

partial.description: True when not every captured term was graded. The board must show which.

grades.description: Per-result 0-3, in rank order. Empty when the term returned nothing - which is a coverage failure, not a grade of 0.
